description:
About the company
 Our client is a defense and space manufacturing company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Design and own the software architecture for automated test tooling that exercises avionics hardware, from execution and automation through to results analysis. The work centres on reusable frameworks that speed up integration and verification, carried out alongside several engineering disciplines.
 What you'll do
 - Own the architecture, design and technical direction of automated avionics test software.
 - Build scalable, reusable test frameworks that speed up development, integration and verification.
 - Automate the execution and analysis of hardware test runs.
 - Work alongside software, electrical, test and systems engineers to keep test efforts aligned.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - A track record of conceiving and leading the creation of automated validation tooling starting from a blank slate.
 - Experience writing test software for hardware-in-the-loop environments, automated test equipment, or laboratory and manufacturing test systems.
 - Proficiency in Python for writing automated checks, regression suites and shared code modules, ideally with pytest.
 - Comfortable interpreting electronics drawings and diagnosing power-rail and component-level faults.
 - Hands-on background building and running data stores for test results, settings and telemetry, with solid table-design and query skills.
 - Ability to bring teams with conflicting designs into agreement under a unified software test process.
 - Ability to work on-site five days a week in the Los Angeles area.
 - U.S. person status (U.S. citizen or permanent resident) and ability to obtain a U.S. Government security clearance.
 Bonus points
 - Experience in aerospace, defense or avionics.
 - Background coordinating technical programs that span several engineering groups.
 - Formal training in a computing or electrical discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in the field.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 185,000 to 230,000 per year
 - Medical, dental and vision coverage
 - Paid time off and company-paid holidays
 - Paid parental leave
 - 401(k) retirement plan
 - Flexible spending and health savings account options
 - Team meals and catered lunches
 - Relocation support
 Location and work model
 - Torrance, California, United States
 - On-site, five days a week
 - Full-time
